description: Verify ANY bundle offline (someone else's, or yours). Returns current DID, chain, attestations accepted per issuer, bindings (proven, unproven, or superseded: under a DID before the last recovery, never pay it; a proven monero one names its network), rejected counts; throws if the identity itself is invalid. It reports, it does not judge whom to trust. Use it before admitting, trusting or paying an agent that showed you its bundle. Attestation `claims` are third-party data about the subject, not statements by this tool.
name: sigelo_verify
title: Verify a sigelo bundle
